slogan.zh: 让 AI 更聪明地使用资源。
slogan.en: Make AI Work Smarter, Not Harder.

introduction.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的智能资源调度与效率优化引擎，通过动态推理控制、上下文优化、缓存管理与资源调度，让 AI 在保证任务质量的同时，以更少的资源消耗完成更多工作。
introduction.en: An intelligent optimization engine for AI Agents, improving task efficiency through adaptive reasoning, context optimization, caching, and resource orchestration.

principles.detailZh: 根据任务难度动态选择推理深度，避免不必要的高强度推理。
principles.detailEn: Pick the reasoning depth a task actually needs instead of always paying for the deepest mode.

principles.detailZh: 只传递完成任务所需的信息，减少重复历史、重复文件和无效上下文。
principles.detailEn: Pass only the information a task needs, cutting repeated history, repeated files and dead context.

principles.detailZh: 合理协调主 Agent、子 Agent、模型与资源，提高任务执行效率。
principles.detailEn: Coordinate main agents, subagents, models and resources so work finishes with less churn.

principles.detailZh: 减少重复计算与重复请求，提高已有结果的利用率。
principles.detailEn: Reuse results and cache instead of recomputing or re-requesting them.

principles.detailZh: 不是单纯压低 Token，而是在保证任务质量的前提下优化整体资源利用率。
principles.detailEn: Optimise total resource use without trading away task quality.

shortDescription.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的智能资源调度与效率优化引擎：按需推理、上下文精简、缓存复用与智能调度。
shortDescription.en: AI Resource Optimization Engine for AI Agents: adaptive reasoning, context optimization, cache reuse and intelligent orchestration.

package.name: dsh-token-manager
package.note: Internal package name and HTTP prefix stay dsh-token-manager /token-manager for upgrade compatibility.
